proofs-d-core-browser-accounts.title: Browser authority and account sessions
frontier: Native WebView effects are not claimed by a queued request.

guidance: Queued native browser actions cannot claim an unobserved native result; restored tabs lose runtime liveness and owner grants.
Owner-only browser controls cannot be granted by model requests; runtime effects require the current memory-only capability.
Before queueing, browser navigation accepts only bounded HTTP(S) URLs without embedded credentials.
Configured proof ports are a nonempty subset of assigned local proof ranges; protected runtime ports are refused without contact.
Device labels are short plain platform/browser names; account commands remain allowed by the desktop bridge.
Successful session lookup binds its principal and public id to stored account identity, upgrading shared legacy binding before return; changed/removed identities cannot authenticate.

proofs-d-core-mobile-hosting.title: Mobile preview and hosted entrypoint contracts

Mobile project discovery retains configured app identity and selects the first existing export in the declared priority, including Capacitor and Expo metadata.
Mobile preview injects script-safe configuration before application code, answers dark/light and safe-area queries, and confines root asset references to its capability base.

MCP question branches have durable read-only policy; search/context retain evidence; approved typed plans expose exactly the named saved child contracts, approval hash, parent task and concurrency governor.

Soft deletion retains its timestamped tombstone and removes active context and search entries within the transaction.
Receipt indexes expose only identity/time/receipt, preserve nested runtime provenance and reject cross-conversation access without exposing turn text.
Legacy import reports durable conversation/turn identity growth and repeated import skips the same IDs without duplicating searchable turns.

Signed host approval traverses the actual RPC pairing/request/enqueue/claim/complete path with exact device/actor/session/run binding and an authenticated durable terminal receipt; no physical device action is claimed by scratch verification.
